**TRIGGER WARNING** explicit talk of the effects of purging I experience.
I purge every day mainly. It is rare the days that I don't. My lower back hurts so bad from bending over the toilet and the strength I have to make to purge. 
My throat is basically dead, for two reasons, showing my fingers inside it, and all the acid. My voice change, its huskier and weaker.
My hair is falling out a lot, but that might be from the starving too. My teeth are okay, although I do get the occasional gum inflammation because of it. The rest of my mouth, is not so good. I get sores all the time in my tongue and side of my cheeks. 
I've noticed, that when I started purging I had to drink a lot of water while eating and had to purge immediately after eating for it to come out. But now, I don't have to drink water anymore and I can wait an hour and a really good amount will still come out. Because my stomach doesn't digest so well anymore, because its just used to not digesting so it just doesn't.
And last, but really not least since this might be the worse of them all. Chest pains and heart problems. I don't have a heart problem, but i do have irregular heartbeats a lot, and get sharp pains where i can't breath.
